第一章 急找女大夫(1)
时值二月末，台州的天气已经开始变暖，街上人来人往，比往日多了几分热闹，就是铺面里的小伙计吆喝起来都分外的欢快。
街边卖茶的老汉听得昏昏欲睡，守着茶炉，不时点几次头，很有几分喜感。
“驾——”
突然，一声惶急的声音划破半空，骤然打碎了这份宁静，老汉猛地惊醒过来，还没来得及探看，眼前就是一花，一个红衣女子驾马迅速闪过。
老汉吓得猛然后仰，刚要骂两声，紧接着又有数道马蹄声从后边传来，他扭头一瞧，当先三匹马上都是黑衣蒙面，手持利器的男子，看起来像是江湖人士。
在他们之后努力追赶的两人，则是穿着普通，腰佩长剑，看不出什么来历。
这前一，中三，后二，一行六个人你追我赶，隐约间还有刀光剑影，立刻把整条街道闹得人仰马翻。
“跑那么凶，赶着投胎啊！”
“狗娃，狗娃你在哪儿？”
“哎哟，我的梨子，我的梨，造孽啊……”
老汉胆子小，赶紧往门里避一避，结果刚刚站定，只听“铮”的一声，他原先站的位置，不知从哪里飞来一把匕首，深深没入土里。
老汉瞬间白了脸色，后背冷汗哗哗淌。“老天爷保佑，差点儿见阎王了……”
不说老汉这般倒楣，受了池鱼之殃，只说那三个黑衣人下手是真狠，飞刀一把接着一把，从怀里掏出飞刀，奔着前方的红衣女子射个没完没了。
红衣女子也是个厉害的，闪躲腾挪，每次都与飞刀险险擦身而过。
黑衣人有些心急，失去了准头，一把飞刀扎到了远处的一匹拉车老马。
老马吃痛，疯了一样的跳起来长嘶一声，猛地挣脱缰绳，横冲直撞的往前跑。
事有凑巧，所有人都避退在一边，偏偏有个三四岁的孩童不知道害怕，追着掉在街心的木球跑了出来。
男童母亲在旁人的提示下回头，看到这一幕，吓得厉声喊道：“铁蛋！不要！”
眼看着马蹄就要从孩童身上践踏而过，红衣女子一个飞身跃起，冲过去抱住孩子滚落到街边。

这么一耽搁的功夫，孩子是得救了，但黑衣人也抓住机会甩了三把飞刀过来。
情急之下，红衣女子硬生生平移出去一步，躲过两把，最后一把，却避无可避的没入她的胸口，鲜血瞬间从她的唇角溢出来。
妇人连滚带爬的跑上前，从她怀里接过孩子，看到女子这模样，吓得尖声大喊，“救命啊！来人，快来人吶！”
黑衣人追到跟前，还要动手，身后那两个普通衣衫的年轻男子终于赶到，其中身穿蓝衣的男子直接手持长剑，翻身站在马背上，腾空朝这边掠了过来。
黑衣人显见很是忌惮，不愿意和他纠缠，回头匆匆应付两招，立刻分头撤离。
蓝衣男子想要追赶，但余光看到受伤的女子，只能放弃，回身将她扶起，急着问道：“余姑娘，你怎么样？坚持一下，我这就带你去找大夫！”
“梁哥，人都跑了，怎么办？”另一个同伴追赶不及，只能过来询问。
“以后再抓人，先带余姑娘去治伤。”梁浩海面色凝重，两道墨色眉头紧皱，本来很有把握的事，没想到出了这样的岔子，任谁都高兴不起来。
他轻轻把余姑娘打横抱起，同时朝那妇人问路，“大嫂，请问最近的医馆在哪儿？”
妇人方才吓得厉害，这会儿回了神望向他，就有些看愣了。这公子长得真是好看，剑眉凤目，鼻梁直挺，即便一身普通衣衫也难掩通身的气派。
“大嫂？”梁浩海疑惑挑眉，不经意间流落出几分不耐烦和焦急。
妇人惊了一跳，赶紧忙给他指路，“这条街尽头，就有一家医馆。”
“多谢。”梁浩海点头道谢，抱着余姑娘快步离开，甚至没忘了招呼兄弟，“冯全，跟上！”
“来了。”冯全有些埋怨妇人没看好孩子，害了余姑娘，狠狠瞪了她一眼。
妇人有些心虚，随后扯了儿子的耳朵，怒从心头起，骂道：“混账小子，以后看你还敢不敢乱跑，方才你差点儿就被马踩死了。”
一旁熟悉的街坊赶紧开口劝慰，“小孩子哪有不淘气的，回去教教就是了。”
“是啊，就是不知道那姑娘会怎么样，好像伤得很重。”
“胸口中了一刀，怕是不能活了。”
妇人生怕惹上麻烦，毕竟方才那姑娘可是为了救她儿子才受伤的，于是扯了孩子，匆匆回家去了，众人也就慢慢散了。
这一头梁浩海抱着余姑娘，三步并作两步赶到街尾，果然看见有家医馆，他冲进去就大声喊道：“大夫，大夫赶紧帮忙救命！”

“来了来了，喊什么喊。”医馆后边有人应声，随后蓝色粗布帘子一挑，出来一个白胡子老头儿，问道：“出了什么事儿，病人在哪儿？”
梁浩海赶紧应道：“是我抱着这位姑娘，她中了飞刀，劳烦您快给看看。”
“姑娘？”老大夫皱眉，待得走近，看了眼余姑娘受伤的地方，顿时变了脸色，直接摆手撵人，“她伤的地方太特殊，男女有别，我可没办法替她医治。你们赶紧走，寻别人去看。”
“人命关天！医者父母心，还分什么男女有别！”梁浩海有些恼，耐着性子劝说。
但老大夫就是死心眼儿的不肯救治，最后双手一背，回去后院了。
“梁哥，要不要我把他抓出来……”冯全气得厉害，打算用些手段。
却被梁浩海拦住了，“不成，余姑娘伤得太重，他若是不用心，必死无疑，还是另外再寻大夫。”
“唉！”冯全跺脚，恼道：“余姑娘真是的，若不是为了救那个贪玩的小孩子，也不至于受这么重的伤。”
“好了，赶紧去寻别的大夫。”
梁浩海抱了余姑娘往外走，送他们的小药童有三分同情，出门时忍不住多嘴一句，“二位贵客，这城里的医馆几乎都是男大夫，不会有人医治这姑娘的。倒是城北童家大院的童大小姐，医术精湛，常给城里妇人们看诊，心肠很好，你们不如去试试，但是童家规矩大，日落就要关门，日出才开启，你们怕是赶不上了。”
梁浩海两人听得眼睛一亮，应道：“多谢小兄弟，我们会试试。”
小药童赶紧摆手，笑道：“不过随口一句话，这姑娘也是好人。”
医馆门口正好有马车，梁浩海直接跳上去，吩咐道：“找一家最安静又干净的客栈，最好在城北，快！”
车夫刚要说话，冯全就扔了一块银子过去，车夫立刻闭了嘴，调转马头就奔去城北。
第一章 急找女大夫(2)
台州府城不大，马车跑起来，很快就到了一家客栈前。
梁浩海眼见太阳落山，马上就要天黑，心急之下把余姑娘送到客栈厅堂放下，吩咐冯全，“开一间上房等我，我这就去请那位童大小姐。”
“好，梁哥，你放心……”
冯全说到一半，客栈掌柜就走了过来，原本以为有客人上门，他很欢喜，但是眼见梁浩海两人身上都有血迹，余姑娘更是濒死，他立刻变了脸色，开始撵人，“客官，我们房间已经满了，你们赶紧换一家吧。”
冯全没想那么多，开口就质问，“不可能，又不是赶考时节，你们这个小店怎么可能住满了？”

掌柜却冷着脸，坚持道：“就是住满了，我们今晚不接待客人，你们赶紧走，否则我就报官了！”

Chapter 1 Urgently looking for a female doctor (1)
It was the end of February, and the weather in Taizhou had begun to warm up. People were coming and going on the streets, which was a bit more lively than usual. Even the boys in the shop were particularly cheerful when they shouted.
The old man selling tea on the street felt drowsy after listening to it. He guarded the tea stove and nodded several times from time to time, feeling very happy.
"Drive——"
Suddenly, a panicked voice pierced the air, suddenly shattering the tranquility. The old man suddenly woke up, and before he had time to look around, there was a flower in front of him, and a woman in red quickly flashed past on horseback.
The old man was so frightened that he suddenly leaned back and was about to curse twice when the sound of several more horse hoofbeats came from behind. He turned around and saw that the first three horses were all men in black clothes and masks, holding sharp weapons. They looked like people from the world.
The two people who were trying to catch up behind them were dressed in ordinary clothes and had long swords on their waists. Their origins could not be seen.
The first one, the third one in the middle, the second one in the back, a group of six people were chasing each other, with faint flashes of swords and swords, and immediately caused the whole street to be in chaos.
"You run so fiercely and you rush to be reincarnated!"
"Gouba, Gouba, where are you?"
"Oh, my pear, my pear, what a sin..."
The old man was timid and quickly hid in the door. As soon as he stood still, he heard a "clang" sound. A dagger flew out of nowhere where he was standing and sank deeply into the ground.
The old man's face instantly turned pale, and cold sweat poured down his back. "God bless me, I almost met the King of Hell..."
Not to mention that the old man was so unlucky and suffered the same fate as a fish in a pond, I just said that the three men in black were really ruthless, throwing knives one after another. They took out the throwing knives from their arms and ran towards the woman in red in front of them and shot them endlessly.
The woman in red is also very powerful. She dodges and moves, narrowly missing the flying knife every time.
The man in black was a little impatient, lost his accuracy, and struck an old cart horse in the distance with a flying knife.
The old horse was in pain, jumped up like crazy, neighed, broke free from the reins, and ran forward.
As luck would have it, everyone stayed aside, but a child of three or four years old ran out chasing the wooden ball that fell in the middle of the street.
The boy's mother turned around at the prompt of others. When she saw this scene, she was so frightened that she shouted: "Tiedan! No!"
Seeing that the horse's hooves were about to trample the child, the woman in red jumped up, rushed over, hugged the child, and rolled it to the street.
After such a delay, the child was saved, but the man in black also seized the opportunity and threw three throwing knives.
In desperation, the woman in red took a step forward and dodged two blows. The last one was inevitably buried in her chest, and blood instantly overflowed from the corners of her lips.
The woman crawled forward and took the child from her arms. Seeing the woman's appearance, she was so frightened that she screamed, "Help! Someone, come quickly!"
The man in black chased after him and was about to take action. The two young men in ordinary clothes behind him finally arrived. Among them, the man in blue directly held a long sword, turned over and stood on the horse, and flew towards this side in the air.
The man in black was obviously very wary and unwilling to tangle with him. He turned around and hurriedly dealt with two moves and immediately separated and evacuated.
The man in blue wanted to catch up, but when he saw the injured woman from the corner of his eye, he had no choice but to give up, turned around, helped her up, and asked hurriedly: "Miss Yu, how are you? Just hold on, I'll take you to the doctor right now!"
"Brother Liang, everyone has run away, what should we do?" Another companion couldn't catch up, so he could only come over and ask.
"We will arrest people later, but we will take Miss Yu to treat the injuries first." Liang Haohai's face was solemn, and his two dark brows were frowning. He was sure of something, but he didn't expect that something like this would go wrong, and no one would be happy.
He gently picked up Miss Yu and asked the woman for directions, "Sister-in-law, where is the nearest medical center?"
The woman was so frightened just now that she now repliedShe looked at him in confusion, a little stunned. This young man is really good-looking, with sharp eyebrows and phoenix eyes, and a straight nose. Even ordinary clothes can't hide his majesty.
"Sister-in-law?" Liang Haohai raised his eyebrows in confusion, inadvertently showing a bit of impatience and anxiety.
The woman was startled and hurriedly showed him the way, "There is a medical clinic at the end of this street."
"Thank you." Liang Haohai nodded his thanks, hugged Miss Yu and left quickly, not even forgetting to greet his brother, "Feng Quan, follow me!"
"Here we come." Feng Quan complained that the woman had not taken good care of the child and had hurt Miss Yu, and gave her a fierce look.
The woman felt guilty, and then she pulled her son's ears. Angry in her heart, she cursed: "You bastard, let's see if you dare to run around in the future. You were almost trampled to death by a horse just now."
A familiar neighbor on the side quickly spoke to comfort him, "There are no children who are not naughty. Just go back and teach them."
"Yeah, I just don't know what will happen to that girl. She seems to be seriously injured."
"I was stabbed in the chest. I'm afraid I won't survive."
The woman was afraid of getting into trouble. After all, the girl just got injured trying to save her son, so she took the child away and hurried home, and everyone slowly dispersed.
Liang Haohai hugged Miss Yu and rushed to the end of the street. Sure enough, he saw a medical clinic. He rushed in and shouted: "Doctor, doctor, please help me!"
"Come on, come on, what are you shouting for?" Someone responded from behind the medical center, and then the blue coarse cloth curtain was lifted, and an old man with a white beard came out and asked: "What happened? Where is the patient?"
Liang Haohai quickly responded: "I was holding this girl. She was hit by a flying knife. Please take a look at her quickly."
"Girl?" The old doctor frowned. He came closer and took a look at Miss Yu's injured area. His expression suddenly changed and he waved his hand away. "Her injuries are too special. There are differences between men and women. I can't heal her. You go away quickly and find someone else to look at her."
"Human life is at stake! Doctors are parents, so there is no difference between men and women!" Liang Haohai was a little annoyed and patiently persuaded.
But the old doctor was stubborn and refused to treat her. Finally, he put his hands behind his back and went back to the backyard.
"Brother Liang, do you want me to catch him..." Feng Quan was very angry and planned to use some means.
But he was stopped by Liang Haohai, "No, Miss Yu is too seriously injured. If he doesn't take care, he will definitely die. He should find another doctor."
"Alas!" Feng Quan stamped his feet and said angrily: "Miss Yu, really, if she hadn't saved that playful child, she wouldn't have been so seriously injured."
"Okay, hurry up and find another doctor."
Liang Haohai hugged Miss Yu and walked out. The little medicine boy who sent them was very sympathetic. He couldn't help but say something when he went out, "Two distinguished guests, almost all the medical clinics in this city are male doctors. No one will treat this girl. On the other hand, Miss Tong from Tongjia Courtyard in the north of the city has superb medical skills and often treats women in the city. She has a good heart. You might as well give it a try, but the Tongjia has strict rules. They close at sunset and open only at sunrise. You may not be able to make it."
Liang Haohai and the others' eyes lit up when they heard it, and they responded: "Thank you little brother, we will try it."
The little medicine boy quickly waved his hand and said with a smile: "But just to say it casually, this girl is also a good person."
There happened to be a carriage at the entrance of the medical clinic. Liang Haohai jumped on it and ordered: "Find the quietest and cleanest inn, preferably in the north of the city, hurry!"
Just as the coachman was about to speak, Feng Quan threw a piece of silver over. The coachman immediately shut up, turned the horse's head and ran to the north of the city.
Chapter 1 Urgently looking for a female doctor (2)
Taizhou's capital city is not big, so the carriage started running and soon arrived in front of an inn.
Seeing that the sun was setting and it was going to be dark soon, Liang Haohai anxiously sent Miss Yu to the inn hall to put her down, and told Feng Quan, "Cook a guest room and wait for me. I will go and invite Miss Tong."
"Okay, Brother Liang, don't worry..."
While Feng Quan was speaking, the innkeeper came over. He originally thought that a guest was coming, and he was very happy, but when he saw that both Liang Haohai and Miss Yu were covered with blood, and Miss Yu was dying, he immediately changed his expression and started to chase people away, "Guest, our room is full, please change to another hotel quickly. "
Feng Quan didn't think too much and asked, "It's impossible, it's not the exam season, how can your small shop be full? "
But the shopkeeper had a cold face and insisted: "It's full, we won't receive guests tonight, you should leave quickly, otherwise I will report it to the official!" "
